title: Sentinels of Ether: reverse-engineered craft need psionic assets to fly
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sentinels of Ether: reverse-engineered craft need psionic assets to fly, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Like getting that to fly requires the psionic assets to lock in again on the ground

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, citing a work called Sentinels of Ether and a man named Jake Barber, says that craft copied from recovered non-human technology need "psionic assets" to fly. In his telling, these are people with psychic abilities who must mentally lock in with the craft from the ground, which would mean the technology runs partly on the human mind.
